title: A decent space has finitely many irreducible components above any closed point of a Noetherian base

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite fibre over closed points
standard_prerequisites.use: Finiteness of the fibre of the closed point.

core_obligations: Each irreducible component above the closed point has a decent generic point mapping to it.
Distinct components have distinct generic points; the generic points all lie over the closed point.
The fibre over the closed point is finite; conclude finitely many components.
proof_roadmap: Generic points; distinct images; finiteness finish.
difficulty_reason: A three-step counting argument on generic points.
